title: VentureSentimentScore
description: Investability Scorecard — TDK-style 7 categories × 5 sub-criteria, each scored 0 / 0.5 / 1. Total /35. Replaces v1's 6-dimension weighted-geometric model with a simpler, more transparent sum that maps cleanly to industry-standard VC scorecards (TDK Ventures, GoingVC, NfX). Authored at /sentiment/score.md in each engagement repo.

categories.description: The seven scoring categories. Each holds five sub-criteria, each scored 0, 0.5, or 1. Per-category total = sum of sub-criteria (max 5). Overall composite = sum of categories (max 35).

category.description: Five sub-criteria keyed by stable slug (see reference_venture_sentiment_score.md for the canonical question per slug). Validator rejects unknown slugs and requires all five for the category.

score.description: 0 = not met / no evidence · 0.5 = partial evidence · 1 = clearly met. null = not yet assessable at the current engagement phase.

note.description: One-sentence operator explanation. MANDATORY when score < 1 (validator enforces) — investors need to see the why.

ref.description: Evidence citation as `path/to/file.md` or `path/to/file.md:line`. Resolves to a GitHub deep-link via the portal's repo field. Strongly recommended; operator-rated scores without ref fields are flagged in the Diligence Heatmap.
